edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the `from` of _transfer, and the caller-controlled path triggers an external Uniswap swap and ETH payouts before balances are settled, enabling reentrancy.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the token sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is checked and reduced.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
manualswap authorization is a raw msg.sender equality test against dev, marketing and owner.
manualsend authorization is a raw msg.sender equality test against dev, marketing and owner.
constructor mints the entire supply to _msgSender().
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing _owner to _msgSender().
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing _owner to _msgSender().
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
transfer delegates all logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates all logic to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
_transfer performs the contract-token swap before the sender/recipient balances are updated, giving an external call window.
_transfer sends contract ETH to fee addresses in the middle of the transfer flow.
_transfer settles balances through _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
_transferStandard mints the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains r/t amounts from _getValues.
manualswap lets a privileged caller force a swap of the contract token balance.
manualsend lets a privileged caller drain contract ETH to the fee addresses.
_rOwned balances are debited and credited with sub/add in _transferStandard.
_isExcludedFromFee zeroes the fees inside _transfer for exempt accounts.
the bots mapping blocks transfers through require(!bots[from] && !bots[to]).
preTrader decides whether a transfer bypasses the tradingOpen gate.
_rTotal is reduced by rFee with SafeMath sub.
_tFeeTotal is increased by tFee with SafeMath add.
_redisFeeOnBuy sets _redisFee for buys.
_taxFeeOnBuy sets _taxFee for buys.
_redisFeeOnSell sets _redisFee for sells.
_taxFeeOnSell sets _taxFee for sells.
_redisFee is consumed by _getValues to compute tFee.
_taxFee is consumed by _getValues to compute tTeam.
_developmentAddress receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_marketingAddress receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
uniswapV2Router is the external contract invoked during swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Pair comparison decides buy vs sell fee selection.
tradingOpen gates transfers when the sender is not a pre-trader.
inSwap guards the automatic swap against nested execution.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount is enforced with require(amount <= _maxTxAmount).
balanceOf(to) + amount is compared with _maxWalletSize.
setMaxWalletSize overwrites the wallet cap without any bound check.
setMaxTxnAmount overwrites the transaction cap without any bound check.
setTrading flips the trading gate that governs all transfers.
_allowances[sender][spender].sub(amount) is evaluated in transferFrom.
approve routes the allowance write through _approve.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setTrading to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setFee to _owner, allowing arbitrary fee configuration.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setBlockBots to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts toggleSwap to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setMaxTxnAmount to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setMaxWalletSize to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts allowPreTrading to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts renounceOwnership to _owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership to _owner.
manualswap additionally accepts the owner address as an authorized caller.
manualsend additionally accepts the owner address as an authorized caller.
toggleSwap rewrites the swapEnabled flag that controls automatic swaps.
setBlockBots writes the bots blacklist used to censor transfers.
allowPreTrading writes the preTrader mapping that bypasses the trading gate.
swapTokensForEth hands control to the external Uniswap router before the caller's balances are settled.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to the development address.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to the marketing address.
transferFrom performs an allowance subtraction that must not underflow.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_getValues drives the tAmount*fee/100 arithmetic that determines transfer amounts.
the constructor performs an external createPair call on the Uniswap factory.
the external router swap can transfer control back into token transfer logic while inSwap is set and balances are still in flight.
